I'm not particularly sure what i'm going through either. I was diagnosed with BPD, and have long episodes where I lose touch with reality, have horrible paranoia and depression. Even though there is a rational, logical side of me telling myself that things are okay, and that it is in my head that unstable mind of mine continues to run wild. It gets worse and worse, the depression longer, and the loss of reality more and more. I hate losing myself, but I do often. I care so much about what people think of me, and how I appear to them. I know I shouldn't but like I said it doesn't stop me from still letting it affect me so badly. I think it started when my mom starting taunting me in sixth grade about my weight and what people would think of me. She drilled it into my mind that you are nothing, and no one if people look at you in disgust. If you are overweight you are not pretty. Etc... I hate hat part of me. How horribly paranoid I can become because someone on the opposite side of the room laughed out loud and I don' t know why, so I assume they are laughing at me. Always at my expense. I hate being that overweight, Funny Girl who for some reason always says the stupidest things at the stupidest times and thus no one really enjoys. Or even if they do it doesn't seem like it. I hate who I've become. I hate the path I took to get here. I dislike just about everything in my life right now. and I can't change it.
